rule: Not used for tuning. No model run until changes driven by the development set are finished; then one pre-declared run, reported whatever the outcome. Any later edit to the cases is a new version.

declared_run.primary_metric: verdict matches reference, all observations in the denominator, pooled over repeats
declared_run.note: Declared before any model call on these cases. Scoring rules are those of score.py at this commit.

runs.status: Seen. Any further use of these cases is no longer a held-out result.
